hypothesis: A posterior-distance certificate saves at least 90% of exact action-score calls and gives at least 10x paired decision p95 speedup against vectorized cached-likelihood EIG in every family, with no action disagreement.
timing_order: alternate exact first and candidate first by step parity
history_policy: exact EIG baseline generates histories; each method sees identical posteriors, actions and outcomes; ablation reports one-step regret, not off-policy end-task success

statistics.unit: seed within family, not individual shots

stop_rules: Abort on invalid likelihood, posterior or certificate disagreement
Evaluate all three declared families before rejection on speed or reuse
No outcome-driven retuning or rerun replacement
Any local pass authorizes only independent preflight, not breakthrough or product claims
protected_inputs: all LongMemEval-V2 held-out or per-question rows
integrity: Commit protocol and implementation before execution; receipt records exact source SHA, protocol/file hashes, runtime, every raw decision, and generated likelihood hashes. Existing result directories must not be overwritten.
